---
name: Pull Request Template
description: Standardized PR template for contributions
title: ""
labels: ["triage", "enhancement"]
assignees: ""
body: |
  Thanks for submitting a pull request! Please fill in the sections below to help us review your changes.

  ## Description
  What does this PR do? Why is it needed? Provide a clear and concise description.

  ## Type of change
  - [ ] Bug fix
  - [ ] New feature
  - [ ] Documentation update
  - [ ] Refactoring
  - [ ] Test addition
  - [ ] Other (please describe):

  ## How was this tested?
  What tests did you run to verify your changes? Please provide specific test commands and results.

  ## Screenshots/Videos
  If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings demonstrating the changes.

  ## Checklist:
  - [ ] Code follows the project style guidelines
  - [ ] Type check passes (`npm run type-check`)
  - [ ] Lint passes (`npm run lint`)
  - [ ] Tests pass (`npm test`)
  - [ ] Documentation updated if needed
  - [ ] Conventional commit format used in commits
  - [ ] PR title follows conventional commits format

  ## Related Issues
  Closes #_____ | Fixes #_____

  ## Additional Context
  Add any other context about the PR here, such as design decisions or trade-offs.
---
